description: Gives Claude the project's TaskGraph state and workflow rules at session start and after compaction. Does nothing outside a TaskGraph project.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/config.json" ] || [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/tasks/tasks.json" ] || exit 0; pre="This project tracks work in TaskGraph, but"; if ! command -v taskgraph >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$pre the taskgraph CLI is not installed. Ask the user to run: npm install -g taskgraph-ai"; exit 0; fi; export TASKGRAPH_SKIP_AUTO_UPDATE=1; if out=$(taskgraph prime --project "$d" 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s\n' "$out"; else out=$(taskgraph prime --project "$d" 2>&1); case "$out" in *"nknown command"*) echo "$pre the installed taskgraph CLI is too old for the plugin. Ask the user to run: npm install -g taskgraph-ai@latest";; *) echo "$pre taskgraph prime failed:"; printf '%s\n' "$out";; esac; fi
